content: U sakwa ka Sardis-witu mu numu nananesootuhidu-matoo e tubokuse meeoo mu netamma, ‘Nu yow Mu Pabe'e. Mu nuka nanetzakwiya'edu nu mabetse'a. Nu no'oko mu manena gi watzekute. Mu numu meeoo mu nanatuukwe, “Mu numu Sardis-witu besa nananesootuhidu,” mee'e pana mu-naga-kwitu gi tunaka'oedyukudu numu nemooagadu.

Mu ka nagutza mooe'ugasoo ka e unnena nakase, unu besa tumayohogonno. Mu sakwa ka suda mu manena ma'wuke besasoo nanesootuhi manegasoo ka o'nosoo mu mane-kwa'nesoo. O'no soo suda mu tumatuguna gi mu-matoosoo kodyukwu.
Huu'yoosoo mu-nagatu besa tu'oedyukute gi suda manakwe, mu saa'a ka Te Naa-baa nu-no manepetugadooa.

Mumme no'oko nuga nanetzakwiyidu ka sutakoo gi nanatoohakuna, o'no mu ooosapa Te Naa-baa'yookwu. Nu ka Te Naa noko mu ooka toha kakasa-ga'yoo, “E nanumu,” mee'e mu natubangakakwu. O'no soo Te Naa mu sootuhikwu ka Te Naa-baa ooosapa nanagwetzoidu gi moobegwa-gakoo.’

U sakwa ka mu Philadelphia-witu mu numu nananesootuhidu-matoo tuwazoo e tubokuse meeoo mu netamma, ‘Nu yow Mu Tubetse Pabe'e, mu nemadanagakwutu, ka mu Te Naa doodooamu manepunnekwutu, ka mu-matu gi ooka mapu'akwutu tuwow.

Nu yow Te Naa doodooamu mu mayugwekese, o'no saa'a soo Te Naa-nabatoosoo besakoo mu sootuhidooa. Nu mu sopedakwatoo tooe namadugedu numu pana, mu besa e naka'oedyukuna besa e tumayohokute ka mumme e tunetammakute.

Mu Jew numu o mu-baa manepunnedu ka besa mu manakwe mu nesootuhidyi, “Numme suu'mu besa Ne Naa doodooamu, okowsoo tutzeapu,” too'e umu meeoo mu nemooagapana ka puusoo ka sutakoo tumayohokuna meehoo unakwe. Nu saa'a 'yoo mu sootunagadooa umu saa'a mu-matusoo kemmase ka tu unnepu sootu'adyise oo nemakodyukudooa. O'no saa'a umu ka mumme unu e kammakuna sopedakwadoona.
Nanasuda namanedu ka yow teepu-koobatu gi tunaka'oedyukudu tokunakena mu ka besa nuka nakatumayohokuna, nu ooosapa mu sootuhinokwu, yise mu magwetzoi petugakwu.
Mu sakwa ooosapa nuka nakatumayohokuno ka pudusoo yaa teepu-koobasoo e kodyu petukwuse.’

No'oko mu nu-matoo nananesootuhidu nu meeoo mu netamma, ‘Mu ka sutakoo gi namatzooekunona. Nu ooosapa Te Naa-tooha mu mayugwenokwu, o'no saa'a mu numme-no'yoodooa ooosapa, eka teepu besa pudu namapudutupudoose.’

U sakwa ka Laodicea-witu ka mu nananesootuhidu-matoo e tubokuse meeoo mu netamma, ‘Nu yow Mu Tubetse Pabe'e. Ooosapa toge kaahenokoo hemma mu tuukwedu. Nu no'oko hemma ka teepu-koobatu matabuepuna, no'oko hekwitu poohwa'e.
Nu no'oko mu-kwitu sopedakwatoo mu waha-tamme tusooyugwedu, mu sakwa nakwitu soohanese sumu-tammesoo tusooyugwe ka besa-tamme.

“Numme ka mooasoo besa manepunnena,” mee mu nasooyugwena, “Oo-mahoo nasoonatzina gi hemma soogwi,” mee'e mu sokwama. Ooonne'yoona mu gi ka Te Naa nanetzakwiyina. Ka nuga pooha manepunnena gi sooheesoobedyana mu muusoo nanemoo'aka ka gi nuka nanetzakwiyina nu gi mu sootuhi-wa'ne'yoo.
Mu ka ooosapa nu-matoo nanesootuhinona nu mu nakasootuhise, yise mu nu-kwitu nakasopedakwadoose ka nuga besa podo nu-no kaaheno meadabenokwu.
Nu ka mu soobedyana mu nenanawina meeoo mu netamma. Ka gi toge mu mamanena sakwa mu ma'wuse, nuga mumme tutunetammakuna tumayohoku.
Nu mu pa'e mu-matu tooe haga tooe e naka'oedyukudu mu ooosapa nu-no'yookwu nu-nosoo Te Naa besa podo meadabekwu.’

No'oko mu numu nu-matoo nananesootuhidu nu meeoo netammakwu, ‘Tooe haga tooe nuka nanesootuhidu nuka naka'oedyukunodu saa'a nu-no e nanumu nemadanagadooa. Nu punno'o E Naa besa naka'oedyuikupuna, ooonne'yoona nu saa'a no'oko numu nemadunagakwu.’ ”
